info.title: API.SH: Drugs.com
info.description: The Drugs.com API from API.SH: public Drugs.com data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Medications used for a condition on Drugs.com: each drug's name, id, link, tags (new approval, off-label), user rating, reviews, activity, Rx/OTC, pregnancy category, CSA schedule, alcohol interaction, generic name, drug class and FDA approval date; plus the condition's other names, description and the drug classes to filter by. Filter by drug class, brand/generic, approval and Rx/OTC; sort by activity, name, rating or reviews. 25 a page; pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/drugs-com-condition

The Drugs.com interaction report for 2-10 drugs: every drug-drug interaction with severity and full explanation, plus food/lifestyle, disease and duplication warnings, and the count per kind. `professional=true` returns the professional wording. Limit the kinds with `types`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/drugs-com-interaction-check

parameters.description: 2-10 comma-separated drug names (or Drugs.com ids like 1476-0 from autocomplete).

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated kinds to keep: major, moderate, minor, food, disease, therapeutic_duplication.

get.description:
Every drug known to interact with a drug on Drugs.com, with severity (major, moderate, minor), the other drug's id and the interaction report link, plus counts per severity. `type=disease` or `type=food` returns the disease or alcohol/food interactions with their full text instead. `include_brands=true` lists brand and combination names too.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/drugs-com-interactions

parameters.name: drug
parameters.description: Drug name or slug as in the site's address, or a page link.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: major, moderate or minor (drug interactions only).

parameters.name: include_brands
parameters.description: Include brand and combination names (drug interactions only).

get.description:
User reviews of a drug on Drugs.com: each review's id, the reviewer's initials as shown, condition, time on the drug, date, rating out of 10, text and helpful votes; plus the average rating, total reviews, the per-condition ratings table and the side effects reviewers mention. Filter by `condition` or `side_effect`, search the text, sort. 25 a page; visitors see the first 5 pages. Pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/drugs-com-reviews

parameters.name: drug
parameters.description: Drug name or slug as in the site's address, or a page link.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Words to find in reviews (3-30 characters).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: top (default), most_recent, most_helpful, highest_rating, lowest_rating or time_on_medication.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand slug to see only that brand's reviews (e.g. zestril).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
